rationale: The primary source documents a real $4,200/month unattributed LLM spend problem that required bespoke internal tooling to resolve — a classic 'pain so bad we built it ourselves' signal. This is corroborated by an active HN thread on token-cost management and validated by the existence of funded competitors (Helicone, Langfuse, LangSmith) who charge for adjacent observability, confirming willingness-to-pay in the category. The pain is daily and burning because every LLM API call made without cost attribution compounds the financial opacity.
